set.body: Specify the mathematics and execution contract for compressed ReducedRankGls when each voxel has its own AR whitening transform. Resolve whether a coherent shared response subspace exists, whether voxels must be grouped by whitening geometry, and how conditional/bootstrap covariance, chunk invariance, and export provenance behave. Acceptance: an in-repo design records the chosen geometry and rejected alternatives; implementation is permitted only with an independent oracle plus JVM/JS batch-vs-chunk tests; until then the compressed voxelwise-AR path remains a typed unsupported boundary.
set.title: Design compressed RRG under voxelwise AR whitening
